dedupe_keys.name: sabah onshore plastic waste rgb and rgnir image database

description: This database provides plastic-waste images in RGB and red-green-near-infrared colour spaces for testing waste detection. The research contributors report 405 images in each colour space, resized to 415 by 415 pixels, with 1,344 annotated objects reported in the article. Coverage consists of beaches and a riverbank around Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia; acquisition dates were not established. An iPhone and a Mapir camera supply the two image types. The GitHub README also names dark plastics, caps, labels and background examples. Zenodo archives version 1.0 free under CC BY 4.0, while the current GitHub repository has no separately identified licence. Limited locations and sensor differences constrain transfer to other waste-sorting environments. Modellers could calibrate detection components for waste-monitoring simulations; model-dumped-waste-uav-detection is a related model with a different sensing context. The review inspected metadata and README documentation only, without downloading images or treating the two colour-space collections as proven pixel-aligned pairs.
